question: Which country is associated with the ‘Navam Perahera’ festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The annual **Navam Perahera** festival was held at the **Gangaramaya Temple** in **Colombo, Sri Lanka**.
 
• The celebrations involved scores of **monks**, **drummers**, dancers, and elephants, hailing predominantly from the central part of the island nation.
 
• Throngs of people descended upon Colombo from **various regions of Sri Lanka to participate in the city's largest Buddhist procession**, with festivities.
 
• Women and men performs a traditional Sri Lankan dance in a procession in front of the Gangaramaya Temple during the Navam Perahera festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eid ul-Fitr**- It is the biggest Muslim festival celebrated in **Bangladesh.**
 
• The biggest and most popular festivals in **Nepal **are **Dashain **and **Tihar**.
 
• **Thimphu Tshechu Festival** is celebrated in **Bhutan **with great pomp and show.
